We need to get a lot of heavy damage to take down this slow but menacing foe.|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 10 (Formerly, [[Polluted Wasteland II|Nuclear]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Super Mutant''', internally referred to as '''Mutated Boss''', a name still used by its legacy version, is an [[Enemies|enemy]] that appears in [[Polluted Wasteland II]]. It has high health and a slightly fast speed. The '''Super Mutant''' could be spawned by the [[Nuclear Monster]]. This means it could also appear in [[Oops! All slimes!]], if spawned by the [[Nuclear Monster]]. It also could be spawned by the [[Mystery]] and [[Mystery Boss]]. ==Appearance== The '''Super Mutant''' has a chartreuse skin color and a black torso, waist and legs. It wears black armbands with grey spikes. Veins are visible on its head and arms. It is faceless and it emits light green particles. ==Strategy== *Strong early-game towers like the [[Golden Crook Boss]], [[Golden Cowboy]] or [[Engineer]] can be used to deal decent damage to it. **Expensive high DPS towers like the [[Pursuit]], [[Accelerator]] or [[Ranger]] can be bought for this wave if possible, though it is not necessary. *Because the '''Super Mutant''' moves quite quickly for its high health, slowing towers like the [[Electroshocker]], [[Freezer]] and [[Sledger]] can be useful against this. *Defense dropping towers like the [[Golden Pyromancer]], [[Cryomancer]] or [[Freezer]] can be used to drop its defense, while also being able to slow it down or deal with hordes of enemies that spawn alongside it. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseMutatedBoss.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} IndexMutatedBoss.png|'''Super Mutant''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Super Mutant's''' name may be a reference to [[w:c:fallout:Super mutant|Super mutants]] from ''Fallout''. ==Update History== *'''29 July 2022''' -
